defect: The fix only changes the test's CREATE INDEX statements to request the order_index explicitly.
reason: This is a test adaptation to a changed default index type, not a repair of a defect in the test code.

defect: ListColumnReader::Read calls child_result.Reset() at the start of every call, which resets data[1] (the overflow slice kept for the next call) to its cache buffer, so list child values spilling over a Read boundary are lost, and data[0] is reused across loop iterations.
reason: The fix drops the DataChunk/Reset scheme for a fresh vector per read plus a persistent overflow vector; it also fixes the older zeroing of overflow defines, but the Reset/overflow defect is in lines this change added.

defect: The fix prints 'row' instead of 'rows' when the count is 1.
reason: This is a cosmetic wording change; before this change the label was already always plural ('Rows').

defect: The fix passes GetError() (a string) instead of the PreservedError object to the %s exception format, and uses HasError() instead of success.
reason: The old code already passed the PreservedError (error) to the format; this change only renamed it to GetErrorObject(), so the wrong argument was there before.

defect: The fix replaces GetErrorObject() with GetError() in exception messages and !success with HasError().
reason: Those lines were not written by this change (error was still a string here); the fix is a follow-up API cleanup.

defect: The fix rewrites AddRowGroups so qualifying tuples are counted only from row groups that are fully resolved in order, instead of setting qualifying_tuples to all seen tuples once the current group clears the last resolved boundary.
reason: The same over-count, which stops the scan early and drops row groups for top-N, was already present in a worse form in the row_limit code this change replaced (edd86f9); this change only partly fixed it.

defect: InspectTableFilters drops the 'no catalog table' early return, casts any get->bind_data to TableScanBindData, calls get->function.statistics unconditionally (null for arrow_scan) and dereferences base_stats without a null check, which segfaults on non-table scans.
reason: The fix adds the bind_data/arrow_scan guard around exactly the statistics call this change introduced.

defect: The fix makes the referential_constraints view match referenced tables and columns case-insensitively, using the referenced_table/referenced_column_names fields.
reason: The case-sensitive join on name_extract['target'] = c.table_name existed before this change (issue #12863 predates it); this change only changed how constraint names are produced.

defect: The fix swaps the misleading names grouping_local_state/grouping_global_state back.
reason: The swapped names still passed global then local state in the right order, so behaviour was correct; the fix is a rename.

defect: The fix also shows ETAs above 99 hours as unknown so the fixed-width display does not overflow.
reason: This is a display refinement for the later fixed-width format, not a defect in the negative-ETA check this change added.

defect: The new string-padding code computes bytes_to_fill as entry_size % 8 instead of the slack to the next 8-byte boundary (8 - entry_size % 8), so it gives strings the wrong number of extra prefix bytes before AlignValue.
reason: The fix ('fix alignment issue') changes exactly this expression, which this change introduced; the effect is a wrong layout and wasted entry space rather than wrong sort results.

defect: The fix changes the per-thread memory fraction from 1/5 to 1/4.
reason: This is a tuning-constant change, not a defect repair.

defect: The fix makes TypeCatalogEntry::ToSQL emit CREATE TYPE for any user type (stripping the alias) instead of throwing for non-ENUM types.
reason: Throwing for non-ENUM user types predates this change, which only delegated the ENUM case to CreateTypeInfo::ToString; export of such types never worked.

defect: The fix resolves a plain USER alias via Catalog::GetType and, for other types, binds only to validate while storing the original unbound type, so that the new export ToSQL can print the definition.
reason: This supports exporting non-ENUM user types, which already failed before this change (ToSQL threw for them); it is part of a feature fix, not a defect introduced here.

defect: The new rule rewrites a * 0 to 0 and 0 / a to 0, which gives a wrong result when a is NULL.
reason: The fix removes exactly these two rewrites that this change added.

defect: The fix makes Flush always merge collections starting from the first (in batch order) instead of the biggest one, which lost the insert order.
reason: The biggest-collection merge logic was added later by e7ad65b, not by this initial version of PhysicalBatchInsert.

defect: The fix gives the single-column UniqueConstraint constructor the column name and removes SetColumnName, so binding no longer mutates the original constraint.
reason: SetColumnName and the binder mutating it predate this change (since 21f34f5); this change only added const qualifiers and helper methods.

defect: The fix makes BindConstraint/BindUniqueConstraint take a const Constraint&.
reason: This change only renamed a parameter; the mutation of constraints during binding came from older code.

defect: The fix passes the column name at construction, removes SetColumnName and updates Copy, so BindConstraints no longer modifies the original constraints (#16959).
reason: This change only moved existing methods (including SetColumnName) out of the header; the mutating binder call predates it.

defect: The fix stops BindCheckConstraint/BindUniqueConstraint from rewriting check.expression and calling unique.SetColumnName on the original constraint.
reason: Those mutating lines are unchanged context in this change, which only made BindUniqueConstraint a Binder member.

defect: The fix removes the leftover swap_status member, which no longer compiled after a merge brought it back while the SWAP_STATUS enum had been removed on the other branch.
reason: The member was valid in this change's own history; the breakage came from the merge, and the fix is merge-conflict cleanup.

defect: The fix removes the swap_status initializer and the swap_status-based binding selection that a merge left behind after the enum was removed (compile failure, and the value was never set).
reason: The persistent-swap_status logic had already been reworked on the parallel branch (934c087); the fix only resolves merge leftovers, so the defect it repairs comes from the merge, not from this change.

defect: The new header includes add.hpp, multiply.hpp and subtract.hpp by relative path instead of duckdb/common/operator/..., which breaks the amalgamation build.
reason: The fix ('fix for amalg') replaces exactly these three include lines added by this change.

defect: The new HashInternal hashes with the selection vector, which writes hashes at sel positions into hashes_v sized only approved_tuple_count (out-of-bounds write and non-dense hashes), so tpch crashed.
reason: The fix replaces HashInternal with a plain dense Hash call and its message says queries no longer crash; it requires knowing VectorOperations::Hash writes at rsel indexes.

defect: The fix passes the full LogicalType instead of type.id() to UnaryAggregateDestructor so type info (such as collation or alias) is not lost.
reason: The type.id() arguments predate this change, which only swapped the state type on that line.

defect: JoinElimination keeps a single join_parent/left_child/right_child, so a pass that meets several joins under different operators (e.g. union or cross product) overwrites the state (D_ASSERT(!join_parent) fails) and can eliminate a join using another join's child information.
reason: The fix replaces these single members, which this change added, with a vector of per-join stats; seeing the problem needs the cpp's traversal.

defect: The new can_add check looks up projection output bindings (projection.table_index, idx) in the child's distinct group, which holds bindings of another table, so it never matches and distinct groups never propagate through projections.
reason: The fix replaces this check with tracking of the referenced child column indexes; the mismatch is visible from the context lines in this change's diff.

defect: The fix includes duckdb/common/unique_ptr.hpp instead of <memory>, because the header uses duckdb::unique_ptr.
reason: The missing include predates this change; adding <memory> did not cause it but also did not fix it.

defect: This change introduces the LogLevel enumerator ERROR (and its EnumUtil mapping), which collides with the ERROR macro from windows.h and breaks Windows compilation.
reason: The fix renames it to RECOVERABLE_ERROR in this exact line and in the enum this commit introduced.

defect: The fix renames LogLevel::ERROR to RECOVERABLE_ERROR to avoid the Windows ERROR macro.
reason: The ERROR enumerator name existed before (fece7bd); this change only renumbered it.

defect: The fix makes ShellHighlight::state public so the renderer and PrintText can write to state.out.
reason: Making state private was not itself a defect; the output bugs the fix repairs (double print, writing to stdout) are in shell.cpp and shell_highlight.cpp.

defect: The fix removes a duplicate utf8_printf in ShellState::Print(const char*), routes non-highlighted output to state.out and makes highlighting default to console detection.
reason: The double print came from 186fb71, which added Print(STDOUT, str) before this line; at this change Print printed once, and the other fixed lines are later code.

defect: The fix makes PrintText write to state.out instead of stdout.
reason: This change moved existing code; the same fprintf to stdout was already in shell.cpp before the move.

defect: After returning the cached chunk with Reference, this change clears it with SetCardinality(0) instead of Reset(), so the cache keeps the shared buffers and stale validity masks and later appends produce wrong NULLs (#2102).
reason: The fix reverts exactly these two lines to Reset().

defect: The fix removes leftover LoadSubtypes overrides and stash conflict markers after the import-cache redesign.
reason: The conflict markers and the now-invalid overrides come from 0d9ac46; this change's LoadSubtypes was correct for its API.

defect: The redesigned PyDuckDBCacheItem registers the attribute as 'value' instead of pyduckdb's 'Value' (the old code loaded 'Value'), so the import fails.
reason: The fix renames it back to Value in exactly the line this change added.

defect: The fix moves the lock.unlock() calls and the D_ASSERT so the cache entry is registered under the cache lock before the database is created.
reason: The unlocking logic was added by later commits; this change created the instance with the cache lock held for the whole time.

defect: The fix changes the test tag from [integration] to [api].
reason: This is a test configuration change.

defect: The fix uses TryCast when converting Parquet min/max stats and falls back to unknown stats for out-of-range values (#15221).
reason: The throwing DefaultCastAs calls predate this change, which only swapped the min/min_value preference.

defect: bind_quantile now pops the quantile argument, so quantile(x, 0.1) and quantile(x, 0.9) differ only in bind data; QuantileBindData has no Equals and BoundAggregateExpression::Equals ignores bind data, so the optimizer merges them and returns wrong results.
reason: The fix adds QuantileBindData::Equals and compares bind_info in BoundAggregateExpression::Equals, with a test of three quantiles in one query; seeing it needs the aggregate expression's Equals.
